div.div:
Outbound CDC only — like Review, Challenges consumes no events.
Sparse GSI1. Only the PUBLIC item carries the projection attributes; the ANSWER item (the answer key) is structurally unreachable through the public read path.
Redemption debits points only — converting points into a currency discount is Pricing's alone (CustomerDiscounts module, ADR-0046), which consumes PointsRedeemedEvent.
